sloka: ये ये महाबलाः सन्ति लघवश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।लङ्कामभ्युत्पतन्त्वाशु गृह्योल्काः प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.७५.३ ।।
transliteration: ye ye mahābalāḥ santi laghavaśca plavaṅgamāḥ।laṅkāmabhyutpatantvāśu gṛhyolkāḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.75.3 ।।

translations.english: "Of the bulls among vanaras, endowed with prowess, whoever is quick, able and foremost, let them go to Lanka, the abode of Ravana."
